mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and increasing the present value of equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 8.0% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, increasing recession risk and prompting equity investors to demand higher risk premiums, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in fewer than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in fewer than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real output, signaling a weakening economy and reducing corporate profitability, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in fewer than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPIAUCSL above 2.5% year-over-year, combined with a stable or rising FEDFUNDS rate, signals persistent inflationary pressure that triggers a hawkish monetary policy response, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in fewer than 60% of instances where both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS are elevated, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 200k per month, combined with a declining unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals a tight labor market that may lead to wage pressures and inflation, prompting the Fed to tighten policy, which reduces equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 200k and UNRATE declines > 0.2pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in fewer than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 400,000 million dollars, combined with rising housing starts (HOUST), signals strong aggregate demand and consumer confidence, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in fewer than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0, combined with a contraction in GDP (GDPC1) on a quarterly basis, signals a deepening supply-side contraction, increasing recession risk and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in fewer than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
